metadata.description: Programmatically controlled dialog service for dynamic content
usageExamples: // Used with DialogService: dialogService.open(MyComponent, { header: 'Title', data: { id: 1 } })

styling.name: className
styling.description: Additional CSS classes for custom styling
styling.helpText: Supports PrimeFlex utility classes and custom CSS

patterns: Use DialogService to open dialogs programmatically
Pass data to dialog components through DialogService options

childComponentInfo.childrenDescription: This component is controlled by DialogService and does not accept children directly. Content is provided through DialogService.open().

usageExamples.withEvents: // In component: const dialogRef = dialogService.open(ProductForm, { header: 'Add Product', onHide: () => console.log('closed') })
usageExamples.withRedux: // dialogService.open(EditForm, { data: { id: productId }, onHide: () => dispatch(refreshProducts()) })
